comment: Laya typed question pack — routes a spoken request to a v1 skill. Band routing (act/confirm/abort) is done by app code on the returned confidence, never by the model.
state: raw transcript of the user's spoken request, plus the current date and time

skill.instructions: Which routine is the user asking for?

criteria.pay_bill: paying a utility, insurance, or credit-card bill
criteria.read_mail: reading email or text messages aloud
criteria.scam_check: asking whether a message, call, or letter is a scam
criteria.reminders: setting or checking reminders, medications, appointments
criteria.read_document: reading or explaining a letter, bill, or photo of text
criteria.call_contact: calling or texting a specific person
criteria.app_help: asking for help using the assistant
